scope: Independent review of MTZ-Logi.ps1; new adapted progress/state tests only, no production edits by this agent.
regressions_found_and_fixed_by_root: Canceled result used coercive equality and bypassed success/exit-code validation. Now bool types and Success=false / exit3 are required.
A JSON string root could pass the loose PSCustomObject check. Preferences now require a raw JSON object and exact parsed object type; arrays/scalars are rejected.
coverage: Diagnostics defaults for new users; legacy Full, valid profile and conversation preserved.
Clearing a remembered conversation persists; invalid edit does not replace a valid URL.
Known immediate launcher directories only, no automatic profile selection, cap200, linked and nested fixtures excluded.
Real separate-process application-lock contention and reacquisition after release.
Cancel never invents100 or displays an error for a valid cancellation; malformed cancellation JSON is rejected.
Close confirmation and cleanup run asynchronously, no WaitForExit/Kill in the normal close path.
Real pre-canceled workers and Full cancellation during observed large-file copy return exit3; source and earlier packages survive.
Existing byte-progress, bad/partial ZIP, failure, multipart selection and exact restoration regression cases retained.
note: Test cases execute production functions and event branches. Fake controls and a stub for the single visual MessageBox confirmation do not prove Windows layout or native UI behavior.
